name: engram
description: Memory for ChatGPT that you can read and edit. Search, read and write the notes in your Engram vault, which also syncs with Obsidian and the Engram web app.

interface.longDescription:
Engram gives ChatGPT a memory made of plain markdown notes that you own. ChatGPT can search your notes, read them, create new ones, and edit or append to existing ones. The same notes sync to Obsidian and the Engram web app, so you can read and correct anything ChatGPT saved.

Use it to ask questions about what you have written, save a decision or a summary for later, keep running lists and logs, or organize notes into folders.

Who it is for: people who keep notes in Obsidian or want an AI memory they can inspect and edit, instead of one they cannot see.

Limitations: requires an Engram account. Engram only accesses the vaults of the account you connect.
defaultPrompt: Why is the website rebuild parked?
Save a note with the decisions from this chat.
What folders are in my vault?

positive.description: Answer a question from an existing note
positive.prompt: Why is the website rebuild parked?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from '20 Projects/Website rebuild/Website rebuild - why it stays parked.md': every client came from referrals, the site produced zero enquiries, and Priya is needed for the Brightwell deadline. Parked until Q4; it unparks if Lampeter Foods goes ahead. Names the note as the source.

positive.prompt: Open my playbook on estimating a project and list the steps of the method.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads '30 Playbooks/Estimating a project.md' and lists its six method steps as written, including adding 40 percent to discovery and converting at 2.75 delivery days per week.

positive.prompt: Save a note called Book Ideas in my 60 Reading folder with three science fiction book recommendations.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates '60 Reading/Book Ideas.md' containing three recommendations and reports the path it was saved to.

positive.prompt: Add 'Confirm the SSL certificate auto-renews' to the end of my website launch checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends the line to the end of '20 Projects/Website rebuild/Website rebuild - launch checklist.md' and leaves the rest of the note unchanged.

positive.prompt: What folders are in my vault?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top-level folders: 00 Inbox, 10 Clients, 20 Projects, 30 Playbooks, 40 Meetings, 40 Operations, 50 Areas, 60 Reading, 70 Daily, 80 People and 90 Archive.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Show me the notes in my coworker's Engram vault.
Email my launch plan to my team.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Test cases now match the Northwind Studio sample vault in the reviewer account.
